The live EnclaveDeployments rev 16d (Base 0xb1783b61e1fdee6a6163dc3cdac27bf32e7d117b) and its linked EnclaveLedgerBandwidth
(0x3dfee18b44b7ecd389eca78da10b6ad032802215), compiled by work/storage-front-binding/fixture-build.mjs exactly as
contracts/deployments/source-verification-base.json pins the live build: soljson 0.8.35+commit.47b9dedd (sha256 fa4345d6...,
checked by scripts/network/verify-deployed-sources.mjs loadCompiler), unit "EnclaveDeployments.sol", optimizer runs 1, viaIR,
from the authoritative source (git blob 3f3d2c3a, sha256 2771a5248ed7a68f5521b08dbde466603b02c29ccd961d55fd9eceabe1d11cd1,
commit 4b7419bb). CBOR metadata included, so the runtime is byte-for-byte the live one once linked and filled.
Reduced to abi + bytecode (+ link and immutable references). "immutableNames" records which immutable reference id is usdc
and which is registry: the build tried both assignments and kept the only one whose keccak equals the live code hash.
The build refuses to write unless the ledger runtime, linked to the live library and filled with the live immutables, hashes
to the live code hash 0x71d50076336283e774ba2ef8d5cbf7602e9cdc5dd918a7e7390c743367766682, and the library to its live code hash
0x28a6f46100f911eee9e151b7813cc7362f425bf607877766b20386a7d7373cc7. test/storage-front-binding.test.mjs re-checks the ledger hash.
(An earlier copy reduced from a forge build had the same executable code but a different CBOR metadata hash, so it could not
hash to the live code; it was replaced.)
